017package org.apache.juneau.rest.client.mcp.auth;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.AssertionUtils.*;
020
021import java.net.*;
022import java.util.*;
023import java.util.concurrent.*;
024
025/**
026 * Computes and tracks the SEP-2350 step-up scope union &mdash; the set of scopes a client re-authorizes with after a
027 * server emits a per-operation {@code insufficient_scope} challenge.
028 *
029 * <p>
030 * The <b>mandated minimum</b> union (SEP-2350 "Step-Up Authorization Flow" step 2) is
031 * <code>{previously-requested} &cup; {challenge scopes}</code>, which preserves previously-granted permissions when
032 * servers emit per-operation challenges.  {@link #union(Collection, Collection)} computes exactly that.  The broader
033 * overload {@link #union(Collection, Collection, Collection, Collection, Collection)} additionally folds in the
034 * <i>opt-in</i> contributors the spec permits a client to consult (granted-token scopes, cached PRM
035 * {@code scopes_supported}, and client-metadata scope) &mdash; supplying them widens the union; omitting them keeps the
036 * default at the mandated minimum.
037 *
038 * <p>
039 * The union is <b>order-preserving</b> ({@link LinkedHashSet}) with <b>exact-string dedup only</b> &mdash; scopes are
040 * opaque strings, so {@code repo} and {@code repo:read} are both retained (no hierarchy-aware dedup client-side;
041 * hierarchy reasoning is the <i>server's</i> MUST).
042 *
043 * <p>
044 * As an instance, this class also maintains per-<code>(resource, issuer)</code> accumulated state so a step-up driver
045 * can carry the growing union across successive challenges for the same resource/AS.  Thread-safe.
046 *
047 * @since 10.0.0
048 */
049@SuppressWarnings({
050   "java:S115" // Constants use UPPER_snakeCase convention (e.g., ARG_resource)
051})
052public class McpScopeAccumulator {
053
054   // Argument name constants for assertArgNotNull
055   private static final String ARG_resource = "resource";
056   private static final String ARG_issuer = "issuer";
057
058   private final ConcurrentMap<String,Set<String>> byKey = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
059
060   /**
061    * Computes the mandated-minimum step-up union: {@code previouslyRequested ∪ challengeScopes}, order-preserving with
062    * exact-string dedup.
063    *
064    * @param previouslyRequested The scope set the client previously requested (may be {@code null} / empty).
065    * @param challengeScopes The scopes from the server's {@code insufficient_scope} challenge (may be {@code null} /
066    *    empty).
067    * @return A new order-preserving union set.  Never {@code null}.
068    */
069   public static Set<String> union(Collection<String> previouslyRequested, Collection<String> challengeScopes) {
070      return union(previouslyRequested, challengeScopes, null, null, null);
071   }
072
073   /**
074    * Computes the broadened step-up union, folding in the opt-in contributors the SEP-2350 Scope Selection Strategy
075    * permits a client to consult.  Order-preserving; exact-string dedup.  Any {@code null} contributor is treated as
076    * empty.
077    *
078    * @param previouslyRequested The scope set the client previously requested.
079    * @param challengeScopes The scopes from the server's {@code insufficient_scope} challenge.
080    * @param grantedTokenScopes The scopes on the currently-held token (opt-in).
081    * @param prmScopesSupported The cached PRM {@code scopes_supported} (opt-in).
082    * @param clientMetadataScope The scope declared in client metadata (opt-in).
083    * @return A new order-preserving union set.  Never {@code null}.
084    */
085   public static Set<String> union(Collection<String> previouslyRequested, Collection<String> challengeScopes,
086         Collection<String> grantedTokenScopes, Collection<String> prmScopesSupported, Collection<String> clientMetadataScope) {
087      var out = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
088      addAll(out, previouslyRequested);
089      addAll(out, challengeScopes);
090      addAll(out, grantedTokenScopes);
091      addAll(out, prmScopesSupported);
092      addAll(out, clientMetadataScope);
093      return out;
094   }
095
096   /**
097    * Seeds the accumulated state for a {@code (resource, issuer)} key with the client's previously-requested scopes,
098    * <b>unioning</b> into any existing entry for that key rather than replacing it.
099    *
100    * <p>
101    * Unioning (not overwriting) matters when a shared accumulator is seeded more than once for the same key &mdash;
102    * e.g. two {@link McpStepUpAuthorizer.Builder#build() builds} against one shared accumulator, or a re-seed after some
103    * challenge scopes were already {@link #accumulate accumulated} &mdash; so no previously-tracked scope is ever lost.
104    *
105    * @param resource The RFC 8707 resource indicator.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
106    * @param issuer The authorization server issuer.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
107    * @param previouslyRequested The previously-requested scopes.  May be {@code null} / empty.
108    * @return This object.
109    */
110   public McpScopeAccumulator seed(URI resource, URI issuer, Collection<String> previouslyRequested) {
111      assertArgNotNull(ARG_resource, resource);
112      assertArgNotNull(ARG_issuer, issuer);
113      byKey.merge(key(resource, issuer), union(previouslyRequested, null), McpScopeAccumulator::union);
114      return this;
115   }
116
117   /**
118    * Unions the given challenge scopes into the accumulated state for the {@code (resource, issuer)} key and returns
119    * the updated union.
120    *
121    * @param resource The RFC 8707 resource indicator.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
122    * @param issuer The authorization server issuer.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
123    * @param challengeScopes The scopes from the latest {@code insufficient_scope} challenge.  May be {@code null} /
124    *    empty.
125    * @return A copy of the updated accumulated union for the key.  Never {@code null}.
126    */
127   public Set<String> accumulate(URI resource, URI issuer, Collection<String> challengeScopes) {
128      assertArgNotNull(ARG_resource, resource);
129      assertArgNotNull(ARG_issuer, issuer);
130      var updated = byKey.compute(key(resource, issuer), (k, existing) -> union(existing, challengeScopes));
131      return new LinkedHashSet<>(updated);
132   }
133
134   /**
135    * Returns a copy of the currently-accumulated union for the {@code (resource, issuer)} key.
136    *
137    * @param resource The RFC 8707 resource indicator.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
138    * @param issuer The authorization server issuer.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
139    * @return A copy of the current accumulated union (empty if the key was never seeded/accumulated).
140    */
141   public Set<String> current(URI resource, URI issuer) {
142      assertArgNotNull(ARG_resource, resource);
143      assertArgNotNull(ARG_issuer, issuer);
144      return new LinkedHashSet<>(byKey.getOrDefault(key(resource, issuer), Set.of()));
145   }
146
147   private static void addAll(Set<String> out, Collection<String> in) {
148      if (in != null)
149         for (var s : in)
150            if (s != null && ! s.isBlank())
151               out.add(s);
152   }
153
154   private static String key(URI resource, URI issuer) {
155      return resource.toString() + '\n' + issuer.toString();
156   }
157}
